_comment: Penglai 0.4 Tauri config (reference). The 0.3 config at frontends/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is LEFT UNCHANGED and still drives the 0.3 desktop (Python desktop_bridge.py on :14168). This file is a separate config for the future 0.4 desktop shell whose backend is the TS Host. To use it, create a 0.4 src-tauri (e.g. packages/host/src-tauri) and point Tauri at this config via `tauri build -c ../scripts/tauri-0.4.json`. JSON has no comments, so documentation lives in `_*` fields (Tauri ignores unknown top-level keys).
_backend: The 0.4 shell launches the TS Host instead of python desktop_bridge.py: `node packages/host/src/cli.ts serve --port 14169` (dev, via tsx) or `node dist-runtime/src/cli.js serve --port 14169` (prebuilt runtime from scripts/build-runtime.mjs). The Rust side spawns this as a sidecar/Command at startup and shuts it down on exit. The webview loads the same static UI the Host serves, so it works with or without the local HTTP server.
_nodeRuntime: Two options for Node.js at runtime: (1) require system Node >=22 (simplest; beforeBuildCommand builds the runtime but Node must exist on the user machine), or (2) bundle Node via `bundle.externalBin` below (ship per-target node binaries named node-<rust-target>[.exe]; Tauri resolves the right one per platform). Option 2 is shown but commented-style via the externalBin entry; remove it to require system Node.

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:14169 ws://127.0.0.1:14169 https://github.com https://api.github.com https://objects.githubusercontent.com https://gh-proxy.com; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.longDescription: Penglai 0.4 desktop is the native shell around the TypeScript Host. It wraps the 0.4 web UI and launches the Host (node) as its backend, replacing the 0.3 Python desktop bridge. macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel x64, and Windows x64.
